Lesson 20: EKS vs ECS — when to choose

Content coming soon. Full notes, diagrams, labs, and quizzes will be added later. This lesson is reserved after the core 12-lesson path so navigation and progress stay stable when the material lands.

Why this lesson matters

Lesson 11 covers ECS. Interviewers almost always ask “why not Kubernetes?” This lesson is the decision framework, not a full CKA course.

Learning goals (preview)

  • Contrast orchestration models of ECS and EKS
  • List trade-offs: ops burden, portability, ecosystem
  • Pick a default for common team situations

Hands-on Lab

Cost safety

  • Prefer Free Tier / small instance sizes while learning.
  • Create a billing alarm (CloudWatch or Budgets) on day one.
  • Tear down lab resources when finished (instances, load balancers, NAT gateways).
  • Never put long-lived access keys in code or public repos.

Official practice: AWS Skill Builder · Well-Architected Labs · Free Tier docs

Lab steps will be published with the full lesson. Until then:

  • Prefer Free Tier / smallest resources if you experiment on your own
  • Create a billing alarm before long-running services
  • Tear down anything you create when finished
